capabilities: Render fenced bib blocks as live sliders, choices, cards, tables and charts
Run all of a note's blocks as one shared program with shared state
Feed frontmatter data and bib data blocks into the programs
Keep input values while Obsidian is open without writing them to the file
Match the theme's colours, text size, font and Obsidian control styling
disambiguation: Despite the name, not a bibliography tool; 'bib' blocks are fenced code blocks holding small programs that render interactive UI.
extras: Desktop only. Bundle is about 4 MB because it embeds the .NET runtime; the README states it makes no network calls and touches files outside the vault only on Linux via fontconfig to match the note's font. Unreviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
problem: Obsidian code blocks are static, so notes cannot render interactive, stateful programs bound to the note's own data without writing a plugin.
summary: Fenced-block renderer that runs small bibdoc programs over a note's data, drawing them live as sliders, choices, cards, tables and charts.
